description: This file defines the 'Insert' class for constructing and executing SQL INSERT queries within Drupal's database abstraction layer. It includes methods for setting query parameters, executing the insert, and converting the query to a string.

classes.name: Insert
classes.description: Represents an abstracted SQL INSERT query with methods for building, executing, and stringifying the query.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Insert object with database connection, target table, and options.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Sets the SelectQuery object to fetch rows for insertion.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the insert query, handling multi-row inserts and returning the last insert ID.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the insert query to its SQL string representation.

methods.name: preExecute
methods.description: Validates and preprocesses the query before execution.
